correctness.rationale: For the printed Fu-Xu-Xiao vector field J0=[[0,alpha,0,0],[-10,0,1,0],[0,0,0,1],[0,1,0,0]], independent symbolic expansion gives det(lambda I-J0)=lambda(lambda^3+10 alpha lambda-1). For alpha>0 this cubic has one positive real root and a conjugate pair with real part -r/2; zero is simple. The exact normalized left/right eigenvectors ell=(1,0,0,-alpha), v=(1,0,10,0) give ell^T v=1, ell^T J0=0, J0v=0. Direct Hessian evaluation B(v,v)=(20p,-20,2,0) and projection yield center coefficient (1/2)ell^TB(v,v)=10p. At p=1/5 this is 2, giving xi(t)~-1/(2t) on the negative attracting local center branch. The result is local, not a statement about a distant attractor.
